target_transform: Nearest-rank 95th percentile of every Fy sample in one original raw treadmill trial.
prompt:
Task: Estimate the 95th percentile of vertical ground reaction force over this treadmill running trial.
Target: 95th percentile vertical ground reaction force
Target unit: N
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing.
Field definitions and context: speed_m_s is the imposed treadmill speed. Height is in centimeters and body mass in kilograms. running_level and training_sessions_per_week are recorded participant characteristics.
Input JSON: {"speed_m_s":2.5,"height_cm":181,"body_mass_kg":62,"running_level":"Competitive","training_sessions_per_week":3}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
